name: Isolde's Walk
summary: With the tear sealed, the grim Isolde wants to walk the beacon sites at dusk and show what her master hid.

stages.journal: Isolde stands in the sepulcher's doorway, turning between the paths and back. She wants to walk the beacons.
stages.hint: Follow Isolde to the Crimson, Violet and Emerald beacons, then to the Shadestone Stones.

stages.journal: At the Shadestone Stones Isolde found Yorgrim's last letter to Mori.
Isolde stopped waiting. By morning her lantern had gone dark by the door.
